messages.content: Generate an SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle

reasoning:
The user wants an SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle. Let me create a nice illustration: bicycle with two wheels, frame, handlebars, pedals; pelican sitting on it with a big beak/pouch, wings gripping handlebars. I'll craft coordinates carefully.

Bicycle: wheels centered at (120, 240) and (300, 240), r=45. Frame connecting, handlebars around x=330, seat around x=180, pedal crank at midpoint ~(210,240).

Pelican body sitting above seat, facing right. Body ellipse centered ~(215,170). Neck going up-right to head at ~(285,120), beak long with pouch. Wings reaching to handlebars.

Let me write SVG with gradients, spokes, legs on pedals, feet. Keep it self-contained and reasonably detailed.

Coordinates: viewBox 0 0 400 320.

Wheels: cx1=120,cy=250,r=48; cx2=300,cy=250,r=48. Spokes: lines from center at angles. I'll generate 8 spokes each with lines.

Frame: seat tube from crank (210,250) to seat (185,175); down tube from crank to head tube (295,190); top tube from seat (185,175) to head tube (295,190); chain stay from crank to rear axle (120,250); fork from head tube (295,190) to front axle (300,250). Handlebars: from head tube up to (310,165) then bar going left/right.

Pelican: body ellipse center (205,175) rx 55 ry 34 rotated slightly. Tail at left. Neck: from body top-right (240,155) curving up to head (300,110). Head small circle r 16 at (305,105). Beak: long triangle from head to (365,135) with pouch curve below.

Eye at (312,98).

Wing: shape over body reaching forward to handlebar at (320,170). Legs from body down to pedal: pedal positions: crank center (210,250), pedal at (235,262) right pedal and left pedal (185,238). Legs: from body bottom (220,200) to pedal (235,262).

Let me write paths.

Spokes: I'll use a group with lines: for wheel at (cx,250): lines to (cx±48,250), (cx,250±48), (cx±34,250±34).

Write final SVG with comments. Also ground line.

Beak pouch: path M 316,112 C 340,118 358,128 366,136 C 352,146 330,140 316,126 Z something. Keep simple: upper beak line from (312,108) to (368,128), pouch curve below returning to head bottom (300,120).

Head: circle at (306,106) r 14. Neck path connecting body to head: M 240,150 C 260,120 280,112 296,104 ... with width. Use filled path: M 232,168 C 246,130 268,112 296,96 L 316,116 C 292,130 270,150 258,182 Z.

Let me finalize numbers plausibly; visual perfection isn't critical but must look coherent.

Ground: line y=300.

Wheels bottom at 250+48=298. Good.

Fork: from head tube top (298,182) to front axle (300,250). Handlebar: from (298,182) up-left to (292,160) and grips going back? Actually pelican grips handlebar ahead of head: handlebar stem from head tube (298,182) to (312,158), bar horizontal from (300,156) to (326,158). Wing tips reach grips.

Seat: at (182,172) small saddle ellipse.

Body sits above seat: body ellipse center (208,182)? Seat at 172, body bottom ~205, so bird sits on seat around y=175-210. Body center (210,186) rx 52 ry 32.

Neck from body front top (248,160) up to head (300,110).

Legs: hip near (225,205) to knee (240,235) to foot on pedal (238,262). Pedal crank: crank center (210,250), crank arm to (232,258)? pedal at (232,258). Other pedal (188,242).

Chain: line from crank circle r 14 to rear cog r 8 at (120,250): path M 210,236 L 120,242 and M 210,264 L 120,258.

I'll produce the SVG code now.
